body:
## Pull request overview

This PR addresses spec compliance issues in dashboard widgets across example projects. Dashboard widgets were missing required `DashboardWidgetSchema` fields (`id`, `title`, `object`, and for chart widgets: `categoryField`, `valueField`, `aggregate`), which caused empty property panels and broken configuration workflows.

**Changes:**
- Added spec-compliant fields to all dashboard widgets in CRM, Todo, and Kitchen Sink examples
- Created comprehensive spec compliance tests for dashboard widgets
- Updated ROADMAP.md to track completion

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 5 out of 5 changed files in this pull request and generated no comments.

<details>
<summary>Show a summary per file</summary>

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| examples/todo/objectstack.config.ts | Added `id`, `title`, `object` to 4 metric widgets and `id`, `title`, `object`, `categoryField`, `valueField`, `aggregate` to 2 chart widgets |
| examples/kitchen-sink/objectstack.config.ts | Added `id`, `title`, `object` to 4 metric widgets and `id`, `title`, `object`, `categoryField`, `valueField`, `aggregate` to 3 chart widgets |
| examples/crm/src/dashboards/crm.dashboard.ts | Added `id`, `title`, `object` to 4 metric widgets, `id`, `title`, `object`, `categoryField`, `valueField`, `aggregate` to 5 chart widgets, and `id`, `title`, `object` to 1 table widget |
| examples/crm/src/__tests__/crm-metadata.test.ts | Added 5 new tests validating widget spec compliance: unique IDs, titles, object binding, metric title-label consistency, and chart data binding fields |
| ROADMAP.md | Added completion entry documenting the dashboard widget spec alignment work |
</details>
